items.title: The wallet shows what is actually available to withdraw.
items.detail: Under qualifying gift earnings, a new balance counts only what remains once payout holds and reservations are taken into account.

items.title: New coin gifting is paused.
items.detail: The gift sheet says gifting is paused instead of offering coins, and new Google Play purchase offers can be switched off separately while paid orders are still honoured.

items.title: Legacy complimentary and test coins are retired from the wallet.
items.detail: Balances and transaction history now show only purchased coins and approved rewards; the Wallet row in Settings and the long-press gift shortcut on hearts are gone.

items.title: See your balance and recent transactions in the redesigned Wallet.
items.detail: Open Wallet settings to find the Coins FAQ and choose a display currency by country.

items.title: Browse illustrated coin packs from the gift sheet.
items.detail: Tap the red plus beside your balance to see Google Play prices.

items.title: Open coin recharge from Wallet or the red plus beside your gift balance.
items.detail: The shop shows the packs and prices available in your Google Play storefront.

items.title: Open Coin help from the shop or Wallet for purchase and refund guidance.
Eligible Android users can buy coin packs from the Wallet with Google Play.
items.detail: Kyron verifies the purchase before updating the balance, and unfinished purchases can be checked again in the Wallet.

items.title: Reward-funded gifts now generate withdrawable creator earnings on the same terms as purchased-coin gifts.
items.detail: Source remains recorded for reconciliation; grandfathered weekly complimentary gifts retain their legacy treatment.

items.title: Retire the automatic 100-coin weekly complimentary wallet top-up and its Monday push reminder.
items.detail: Existing unspent grants are preserved as legacy complimentary balances; new coins are issued through approved rewards.
